definitions.explanation: A wide-brimmed summer hat woven from wheat or barley straw, strongly associated with Japanese summers, children on vacation and farm work.

examples.japanese: {麦|むぎ}わら{帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧。
examples.english: I put on a straw hat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{麦|むぎ}わら{帽子|ぼうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: A straw hat is a must in the fields in summer.

examples.japanese: {麦|むぎ}わら{帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶった→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|と}っていた→捕る：28715_toru⟧。
examples.english: Children in straw hats were catching fish in the river.

notes:
Also written {麦藁帽子|むぎわらぼうし}; shortened to {麦|むぎ}わら in casual speech. Hats are worn with ⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麦|むぎ}わら{帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧: to wear a straw hat
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧つば⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麦|むぎ}わら{帽子|ぼうし}: a wide-brimmed straw hat

CULTURAL NOTE:
A child in a straw hat with an insect net is a stock image of the Japanese summer vacation.
